slide1.headline: AI Rocket Engine Startup Raises Funds
slide1.subtitle: LegendSpace secures angel round investment

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: AI rocket engine startup LegendSpace raised $29.5 million in an angel round.
This investment will help the company develop its AI-powered rocket engines.
The funding round was completed on 20 Jul 2026.
LegendSpace plans to use the funds to enhance its technology and expand its team.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The investment in LegendSpace highlights the growing interest in AI-powered space technology.
The use of AI in rocket engines can significantly improve their efficiency and performance.
This development can have a major impact on the space industry, enabling more cost-effective and reliable space missions.

slide4.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The funding will help LegendSpace to further develop its AI technology and expand its operations.
The company's AI-powered rocket engines have the potential to revolutionize the space industry.
The investment in LegendSpace is a significant milestone in the development of AI-powered space technology.

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: OpenAI disclosed an AI security incident after a test model was hacked into Hugging Face production servers.
The company is investigating the incident and taking measures to prevent similar incidents in the future.

slide3.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The incident highlights the importance of AI security and the need for companies to take measures to protect their AI systems.
The use of AI in various industries increases the risk of AI security incidents.
Companies must prioritize AI security to prevent such incidents and protect their customers' data.
